grade_rationale: 2 P1 CVEs (CVSS 9.8 each) eliminate grades A and B; P2 count=7 and spec_coverage=92% satisfy grade C thresholds.

escalations.title: Handlebars 4.7.8 JavaScript Injection — RCE in Source/Backend
escalations.description: Multiple JavaScript injection vulnerabilities via AST type confusion allow arbitrary code execution if template engine processes untrusted input.
escalations.fix: Update handlebars to ≥4.7.9 (or 4.8.0+ for latest patches). Run `npm audit fix` in Source/Backend.

escalations.title: protobufjs <7.5.5 Arbitrary Code Execution — platform/orchestrator & portal/Backend
escalations.description: Arbitrary code execution via malformed .proto files. Platform orchestrator processes untrusted protobuf definitions; exploit could compromise core infrastructure.
escalations.fix: Update protobufjs to ≥7.5.5. Run `npm audit fix` in platform/orchestrator and portal/Backend.

backlog.title: Traceability enforcer blind to portal/ — false-pass verification gate
backlog.description: Default gate scans only ['Source', 'E2E'], reports PASS while 118 portal/ FRs go unchecked. An agent could ship untraced portal code and the gate still says PASS.
backlog.fix: Add 'portal' to source_dirs in traceability-enforcer.py:78 and to inspector.config.yml source.dirs.

backlog.title: Direct DB calls in teamDispatches route handler
backlog.description: db.prepare() called directly inside router.get/router.post handlers. Only route file in Source/ or portal/ violating the 'no direct DB calls from route handlers' architecture rule.
backlog.fix: Extract teamDispatchService.ts with listDispatches() and createDispatch() functions.

backlog.title: 3 production files with zero spec traceability
backlog.description: Three production files implement features with no // Verifies: comments and no matching FR in any Specification or Plan. Violates 'every decision traces to a spec' principle.
backlog.fix: Write spec requirements in an existing or new Plan; add // Verifies: FR-XXX to each file. Coordinate with requirements-reviewer.
backlog.cross_ref: QO-001 (shared root cause: portal/ excluded from tooling scope)

backlog.title: 2 eslint-disable suppressions for react-hooks/exhaustive-deps without explanation
backlog.description: Both suppress exhaustive-deps with no comment explaining why the omitted dependency is safe. Known source of stale-closure bugs in React.
backlog.fix: Either add the missing dependency to the array, or add an explanatory comment (e.g., // currentItemId is a stable ref — intentionally omitted).
